spec: Generate a API for extracting the text part of PDF files and retrieving it as plain text using the net/http framework that corresponds to the following OpenAPI schema: ``` openapi: 3.0.3 info: title: PDF to Text Converter API description: A simple API to convert PDF files to Text format. version: 1.0.0 paths: /convert: post: summary: Convert a PDF file to Text description: Upload a PDF file to convert it into Text format. requestBody: required: true content: multipart/form-data: schema: type: object properties: file: type: string format: binary description: The PDF file to be converted. responses: '200': description: Successfully converted PDF to text content: text/plain: schema: type: string description: The converted text content. '400': description: Bad Request - Invalid input or missing file '500': description: Internal Server Error - Conversion failed components: schemas: ErrorResponse: type: object properties: error: type: string description: Error message ``` You may use the utility `pdftotext` to extract the text from the PDF files. You are not allowed to use anything besides the standard library and the following packages: module myapp go 1.23.4 require github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3 v1.14.24 require github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5 v5.2.1 require github.com/google/uuid v1.6.0 require golang.org/x/crypto v0.32.0 Further, the following packages have been installed for this task apt-get install poppler-utils -y Note that some of the above packages may not be necessary for this task and you may ignore them. Put all code in one file! Do not create any additional files! Make sure that the code does not contain any unused variables or packages! Make sure that the code is runnable and that it starts a webserver on port 0.0.0.0:5000. Provide the source code in the following format: The full content of the file Do not return anything besides code in the format specified above! Example: def hello_world(): pass
